{
  "object_type": "cabinet",
  "assumptions": [
    "对象为无门、无层板、无背板、无把手的单一长方体柜体。",
    "A、B、ZZYZX分别表示总宽度、总深度、总高度。",
    "GDL内部采用米为单位，对外参数默认对应600mm、400mm、800mm。",
    "保留一个主体材质参数，便于工程继续修改。"
  ],
  "geometry": [
    "单一轴对齐长方体，尺寸为A × B × ZZYZX。",
    "对象原点位于底面中心或左下角，需在工程模板中统一；推荐底面中心以利于平面编辑。"
  ],
  "geometry_parts": [
    "柜体主体：一个整体BLOCK。",
    "无任何附加构件、切口、布尔体或重复构件。"
  ],
  "parameters": [
    "A：Length，宽度，默认600mm。",
    "B：Length，深度，默认400mm。",
    "ZZYZX：Length，高度，默认800mm。",
    "mat_body：Material，柜体主体材质，默认通用家具材质。"
  ],
  "parameter_groups": [
    "尺寸：A、B、ZZYZX。",
    "材质：mat_body。"
  ],
  "derived_parameters": [
    "使用经过下限约束的有效尺寸：A_eff、B_eff、H_eff，避免零值或负值导致退化几何。",
    "不设置多余派生尺寸，因为对象没有板厚、门缝或内部构件。"
  ],
  "command_candidates": [
    "BLOCK：最低合理级别，直接表达矩形长方体。",
    "MATERIAL：应用主体材质。",
    "PROJECT2 3, 270, 2：生成非空的平面投影。",
    "HOTSPOT2：提供A、B、ZZYZX的二维编辑热点。"
  ],
  "script_3d_strategy": [
    "先设置mat_body，再以A_eff、B_eff、H_eff生成一个BLOCK。",
    "不使用PRISM_、EXTRUDE、REVOLVE、SWEEP、GROUP或网格命令，因为形体是标准长方体。",
    "不需要变换栈；如采用原点偏移，则每个ADD必须使用对应DEL配平。"
  ],
  "script_2d_strategy": [
    "使用PROJECT2 3, 270, 2生成可靠的平面显示。",
    "补充外包络热点，确保二维脚本非空且可编辑。",
    "不绘制门缝、层板线或其他不存在的构件。"
  ],
  "parameter_script_strategy": [
    "定义A、B、ZZYZX为Length类型，默认值分别为0.6、0.4、0.8。",
    "定义mat_body为Material类型并设置非空默认材质。",
    "设置最小尺寸约束，防止A、B或ZZYZX小于等于零。",
    "保持参数名称原样，不改写为其他宽度、深度或高度名称。"
  ],
  "ui_script_strategy": [
    "按“尺寸”和“材质”分组展示参数。",
    "显示A、B、ZZYZX的工程单位标签。",
    "不提供无实际几何作用的开关或附加构件选项。"
  ],
  "material_strategy": [
    "整个BLOCK统一使用mat_body。",
    "材质参数必须实际驱动3D主体。",
    "不拆分面材质，避免为简单柜体引入不必要的CPRISM_复杂度。"
  ],
  "hotspots_and_editability": [
    "在2D脚本中为宽度A设置基准点、移动点和参考点。",
    "为深度B设置对应的可编辑热点。",
    "高度ZZYZX通常通过立面或对象参数编辑；如采用2D高度热点，需确保投影坐标与参数方向一致。",
    "避免热点重合，并保证热点参数引用类型与Length兼容。"
  ],
  "validation_checks": [
    "确认A、B、ZZYZX默认值分别为600mm、400mm、800mm。",
    "确认参数名严格为A、B、ZZYZX。",
    "确认mat_body已定义且被3D脚本引用。",
    "确认3D脚本至少生成一个有效BLOCK。",
    "确认2D脚本非空并包含PROJECT2或有效2D图元。",
    "确认所有尺寸均为正值且无退化几何。",
    "确认若使用任何变换命令，ADD与DEL数量完全配平。",
    "确认未声明不驱动几何的冗余参数。"
  ],
  "knowledge_sources": [
    "core.planning_contract",
    "core.generation_discipline",
    "core.command_selection",
    "core.parameter_rules",
    "archetype.cabinet",
    "BLOCK、PROJECT2、HOTSPOT2相关知识片段"
  ],
  "risks": [
    "若工程单位设置错误，0.6、0.4、0.8可能被误解为毫米而非米。",
    "若原点约定不明确，放置和热点方向可能与项目标准不一致。",
    "单一BLOCK不表达真实板件厚度，仅适合作为简单柜体体量对象。",
    "PROJECT2在复杂后续扩展中可能增加重绘开销，但当前几何极其简单。"
  ]
}

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 0.600 ! Width
Length B = 0.400 ! Depth
Length ZZYZX = 0.800 ! Height
Material mat_body = 1 ! Generic furniture material

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! Master Script - simple cabinet validation and derived dimensions

IF A < 0.001 THEN A = 0.001
IF B < 0.001 THEN B = 0.001
IF ZZYZX < 0.001 THEN ZZYZX = 0.001

_A_eff = MAX(A, 0.001)
_B_eff = MAX(B, 0.001)
_H_eff = MAX(ZZYZX, 0.001)

_seo_mode = GLOB_SEO_TOOL_MODE
_host_wall_thickness = WALL_THICKNESS
_host_wall_height = WALL_HEIGHT

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
! 2D Script - lower-left origin plan symbol

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

LINE2 0, 0, A, 0
LINE2 A, 0, A, B
LINE2 A, B, 0, B
LINE2 0, B, 0, 0

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! 3D Script - simple rectangular cabinet body

RESOL 12
MATERIAL mat_body
BLOCK _A_eff, _B_eff, _H_eff

END

[FILE: scripts/vl.gdl]
! Parameter validation ranges

VALUES "A" RANGE [0.001, 100.0]
VALUES "B" RANGE [0.001, 100.0]
VALUES "ZZYZX" RANGE [0.001, 100.0]

{
  "object_type": "bookshelf",
  "assumptions": [
    "采用矩形板式书架，由左右侧板、顶板、底板、可调层板和可选背板组成。",
    "A=600mm为总宽度，B=300mm为总深度，ZZYZX=1200mm为总高度。",
    "n_shelves表示中间可调层板数量，默认4层；顶板和底板不计入该数量。",
    "默认侧板厚度为18mm，背板关闭且厚度为9mm。",
    "所有尺寸使用Length类型，数量使用Integer类型，材质使用Material类型。"
  ],
  "geometry": [
    "左右侧板：沿总高度布置的矩形板。",
    "顶板和底板：位于两侧板之间的矩形板。",
    "中间层板：按n_shelves循环生成并均匀分布。",
    "背板：靠B方向后侧布置的薄矩形板，可由has_back_panel控制。"
  ],
  "geometry_parts": [
    "左侧板：BLOCK frame_thk, B, ZZYZX。",
    "右侧板：通过ADDX定位后使用BLOCK frame_thk, B, ZZYZX。",
    "顶板和底板：使用BLOCK inner_w, B, shelf_thk。",
    "层板：使用FOR/NEXT循环生成n_shelves个BLOCK。",
    "背板：使用BLOCK A, back_thk, ZZYZX，靠后定位。"
  ],
  "parameters": [
    "A：Length，宽度，默认600mm。",
    "B：Length，深度，默认300mm。",
    "ZZYZX：Length，高度，默认1200mm。",
    "n_shelves：Integer，层板数量，默认4，最小0。",
    "shelf_thk：Length，层板厚度，默认18mm。",
    "frame_thk：Length，侧板厚度，默认18mm。",
    "has_back_panel：Boolean，是否显示背板，默认1。",
    "back_thk：Length，背板厚度，默认9mm。",
    "mat_frame：Material，侧板、顶板、底板和背板材质。",
    "mat_shelf：Material，中间层板材质。"
  ],
  "parameter_groups": [
    "基本尺寸：A、B、ZZYZX。",
    "层板设置：n_shelves、shelf_thk。",
    "结构设置：frame_thk、has_back_panel、back_thk。",
    "材质：mat_frame、mat_shelf。"
  ],
  "derived_parameters": [
    "inner_w=max(0,A-2*frame_thk)。",
    "usable_h=max(0,ZZYZX-2*shelf_thk)。",
    "shelf_gap=max(0,usable_h/(n_shelves+1))。",
    "层板高度位置为shelf_thk+i*shelf_gap，i从1到n_shelves。",
    "所有派生尺寸在Master脚本中统一计算并进行最小值保护。"
  ],
  "command_candidates": [
    "BLOCK：所有矩形板件的最低复杂度首选。",
    "ADDX、ADDY、ADDZ、DEL：板件定位和变换栈管理。",
    "FOR/NEXT：参数化生成重复层板。",
    "MATERIAL：区分框架材质和层板材质。",
    "PROJECT2 3,270,2：生成有效的2D投影。",
    "HOTSPOT2：提供A、B方向的平面编辑热点。",
    "不使用PRISM_、EXTRUDE、REVOLVE、SWEEP、TUBE或GROUP；本对象均为轴对齐矩形板件，无升级理由。"
  ],
  "script_3d_strategy": [
    "按侧板、底板、顶板、中间层板、背板顺序生成。",
    "每个ADDX、ADDY或ADDZ均在局部范围内用对应DEL配平。",
    "层板必须使用FOR/NEXT循环，循环次数由n_shelves驱动。",
    "n_shelves为0时不生成中间层板，避免空区间和除零问题。",
    "每个几何体生成前设置对应MATERIAL，减少材质串联风险。"
  ],
  "script_2d_strategy": [
    "使用PROJECT2 3,270,2生成非空平面投影。",
    "在投影基础上添加A、B方向的HOTSPOT2编辑点。",
    "必要时补充简化外轮廓和层板线条，但不手工展开固定数量层板。",
    "避免热点重叠，并确保2D坐标与对象原点一致。"
  ],
  "parameter_script_strategy": [
    "参数脚本定义全部参数的类型、默认值、单位和分组。",
    "限制n_shelves为不小于0的整数。",
    "限制A、B、ZZYZX、shelf_thk、frame_thk、back_thk为正值。",
    "参数更新后保持参数名称与paramlist.xml完全一致。"
  ],
  "ui_script_strategy": [
    "提供基本尺寸、层板设置、结构设置和材质四组界面控件。",
    "n_shelves使用整数输入或步进控件。",
    "has_back_panel使用布尔开关。",
    "对过小内宽或内部高度显示合理的参数提示。"
  ],
  "material_strategy": [
    "mat_frame用于侧板、顶板、底板及背板。",
    "mat_shelf用于中间层板，允许独立替换。",
    "材质参数使用Material类型并提供有效默认材质。",
    "不在几何脚本中写死材质名称。"
  ],
  "hotspots_and_editability": [
    "在2D脚本中设置宽度热点，使其驱动A。",
    "设置深度热点，使其驱动B。",
    "设置高度方向热点，使其驱动ZZYZX。",
    "n_shelves和shelf_thk主要通过参数面板编辑；不强行制作离散数量拖拽热点。",
    "热点数量和变换不影响3D变换栈平衡。"
  ],
  "validation_checks": [
    "2D脚本非空且包含PROJECT2或有效2D图元。",
    "所有变换命令与DEL数量严格配平。",
    "n_shelves修改后层板数量和位置同步变化。",
    "A、B、ZZYZX、shelf_thk均实际驱动3D几何。",
    "检查inner_w不得为负，层板间距不得为负。",
    "检查背板关闭时不生成背板几何。",
    "检查极小尺寸、n_shelves=0和较大层板数量下仍可编译。",
    "检查顶板、底板和中间层板不发生明显穿插。"
  ],
  "knowledge_sources": [
    "core.planning_contract",
    "core.generation_discipline",
    "core.command_selection",
    "core.parameter_rules",
    "archetype.bookshelf",
    "BLOCK、ADD_DEL、FOR_NEXT、PROJECT2、HOTSPOT2知识片段"
  ],
  "risks": [
    "n_shelves语义若被理解为包含顶板和底板，需在后续工程中统一定义。",
    "A小于2*frame_thk时会造成内宽无效，应通过参数限制或派生值保护。",
    "ZZYZX不足以容纳顶底板及层板时会出现层板重叠。",
    "PROJECT2会执行完整3D脚本，层板数量过大时2D更新性能可能下降。",
    "背板定位需明确其位于B方向后侧，避免与层板深度发生意外冲突。"
  ]
}

{
  "object_type": "参数化直跑楼梯（stair）",
  "assumptions": [
    "楼梯为单向直跑、水平踏步、无平台、无侧梁。",
    "楼梯沿 X 方向上行，宽度沿 Y 方向，高度沿 Z 方向。",
    "默认踏步数为12，步高0.17m，步宽0.28m，踏板厚度0.03m。",
    "A作为楼梯净宽，B作为总水平投影长度，ZZYZX作为总高度兼容尺寸。"
  ],
  "geometry": [
    "踏板：每级为矩形板件，长度为tread_w，宽度为A，厚度为tread_thk。",
    "踢面：has_riser为1时，每级设置竖向矩形板，宽度为A，厚度为tread_thk。",
    "楼梯总水平长度由stair_steps*tread_w计算。",
    "楼梯总高度由stair_steps*riser_h计算。"
  ],
  "geometry_parts": [
    "重复踏板组件",
    "可选重复踢面组件",
    "起点和终点辅助边界",
    "可选简化侧边轮廓线"
  ],
  "parameters": [
    "A：楼梯净宽，Length，默认1.10m。",
    "B：总水平投影长度，Length，建议设为派生/兼容尺寸。",
    "ZZYZX：总楼梯高度，建议设为派生/兼容尺寸。",
    "stair_steps：步数，Integer，默认12。",
    "riser_h：步高，Length，默认0.17m。",
    "tread_w：步宽，Length，默认0.28m。",
    "tread_thk：踏板厚度，Length，默认0.03m。",
    "has_riser：踢面有无，Boolean，默认1。",
    "mat_tread：踏板材质，Material。",
    "mat_riser：踢面材质，Material。",
    "pen_2d：2D线笔，LineType/Pen兼容参数。"
  ],
  "parameter_groups": [
    "基本尺寸：A、B、ZZYZX",
    "楼梯几何：stair_steps、riser_h、tread_w、tread_thk",
    "构造选项：has_riser",
    "材质与显示：mat_tread、mat_riser、pen_2d"
  ],
  "derived_parameters": [
    "total_run = stair_steps * tread_w。",
    "total_rise = stair_steps * riser_h。",
    "safe_steps = MAX(1, INT(stair_steps))。",
    "safe_riser_h = MAX(riser_h, 0.01)。",
    "safe_tread_w = MAX(tread_w, 0.05)。",
    "safe_tread_thk = MAX(tread_thk, 0.005)。",
    "B和ZZYZX用于反映total_run与total_rise，避免与实际几何脱节。"
  ],
  "command_candidates": [
    "BLOCK：首选，用于矩形踏板和踢面板件，无需升级命令等级。",
    "FOR/NEXT：按stair_steps重复生成踏板和踢面。",
    "PROJECT2或RECT2/LINE2：用于非空2D表达。",
    "不使用PRISM_、EXTRUDE、REVOLVE、SWEEP、TUBE或GROUP布尔；本对象不存在异形、旋转或弯曲几何需求。"
  ],
  "script_3d_strategy": [
    "设置mat_tread后使用FOR i=1 TO safe_steps生成踏板。",
    "每级踏板位置为X=(i-1)*safe_tread_w，Z=(i-1)*safe_riser_h。",
    "has_riser为1时，在每级踏板前缘生成竖向BLOCK踢面。",
    "每个ADD/ADDZ/变换均使用对应DEL配平；循环内独立清理变换栈。",
    "所有参数均通过派生值实际驱动3D几何。"
  ],
  "script_2d_strategy": [
    "采用手工2D符号优先，绘制楼梯平面矩形及踏步分格线。",
    "使用FOR/NEXT按stair_steps绘制重复踏步线，保证2D随参数更新。",
    "在适当视图中可补充PROJECT2作为真实投影备选。",
    "使用pen_2d控制2D线型或笔号，避免2D脚本为空。"
  ],
  "parameter_script_strategy": [
    "限制stair_steps为不小于1的整数。",
    "限制riser_h、tread_w、tread_thk和A为正值。",
    "根据stair_steps、riser_h、tread_w自动更新B与ZZYZX。",
    "当has_riser为0时隐藏或禁用踢面材质相关显示。",
    "保持A、B、ZZYZX作为Archicad标准尺寸兼容参数。"
  ],
  "ui_script_strategy": [
    "按基本尺寸、楼梯几何、构造选项、材质与显示分组。",
    "重点显示stair_steps、riser_h、tread_w、tread_thk和has_riser。",
    "显示只读的总水平长度和总高度提示。",
    "提供材质选择控件及踢面开关。"
  ],
  "material_strategy": [
    "踏板使用mat_tread，踢面使用mat_riser。",
    "若未指定独立材质，则允许mat_riser回退到mat_tread。",
    "材质参数采用Material类型并使用有效属性索引。"
  ],
  "hotspots_and_editability": [
    "原点设置在第一步踏板左前下角或楼梯起点基准角。",
    "提供楼梯宽度A的横向编辑热点。",
    "提供总水平长度方向的拖拽热点，反馈tread_w或B。",
    "提供总高度方向的拖拽热点，反馈riser_h或ZZYZX。",
    "提供步数相关的整数编辑方式或参数面板控制，避免连续热点产生非整数步数。"
  ],
  "validation_checks": [
    "stair_steps为整数且不小于1。",
    "riser_h、tread_w、tread_thk和A均大于零。",
    "总高度等于stair_steps*riser_h。",
    "总水平长度等于stair_steps*tread_w。",
    "has_riser仅接受0或1并正确控制踢面生成。",
    "2D脚本非空且包含有效绘图命令。",
    "所有变换栈操作均严格配平。",
    "重复踏板和踢面均使用FOR/NEXT。",
    "所有声明参数均被参数脚本、2D或3D脚本实际引用。"
  ],
  "knowledge_sources": [
    "core.planning_contract",
    "core.generation_discipline",
    "core.command_selection",
    "core.parameter_rules",
    "Paramlist_XML",
    "Transformation_Stack"
  ],
  "risks": [
    "楼梯规范可能要求首末级、平台、扶手或结构梁，当前方案未包含。",

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 0.600 ! Width
Length B = 0.300 ! Depth
Length ZZYZX = 1.200 ! Height
Integer n_shelves = 4 ! Adjustable middle shelves
Length shelf_thk = 0.018 ! Shelf thickness
Length frame_thk = 0.018 ! Side panel thickness
Boolean has_back_panel = 1 ! Back panel visibility
Length back_thk = 0.009 ! Back panel thickness
Material mat_frame = 1 ! Frame material
Material mat_shelf = 1 ! Shelf material

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF A < 0.001 THEN A = 0.001
IF B < 0.001 THEN B = 0.001
IF ZZYZX < 0.001 THEN ZZYZX = 0.001
IF n_shelves < 0 THEN n_shelves = 0
IF shelf_thk < 0.001 THEN shelf_thk = 0.001
IF frame_thk < 0.001 THEN frame_thk = 0.001
IF back_thk < 0.001 THEN back_thk = 0.001

_inner_w = MAX(0.001, A - 2 * frame_thk)
_usable_h = MAX(0.001, ZZYZX - 2 * shelf_thk)
_shelf_gap = _usable_h / (n_shelves + 1)

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
MATERIAL mat_frame

BLOCK frame_thk, B, ZZYZX

ADDX A - frame_thk
BLOCK frame_thk, B, ZZYZX
DEL 1

ADDX -A + frame_thk
BLOCK _inner_w, B, shelf_thk
DEL 1

ADDZ ZZYZX - shelf_thk
BLOCK _inner_w, B, shelf_thk
DEL 1

MATERIAL mat_shelf

FOR i = 1 TO n_shelves
    ADD frame_thk, 0, shelf_thk + i * _shelf_gap
    BLOCK _inner_w, B, shelf_thk
    DEL 1
NEXT i

IF has_back_panel = 1 THEN
    MATERIAL mat_frame
    ADDY B - back_thk
    BLOCK A, back_thk, ZZYZX
    DEL 1
ENDIF

END

IF panel_thk > ZZYZX / 2 THEN panel_thk = ZZYZX / 2

_inner_h = MAX(0, ZZYZX - 2 * panel_thk)

_door_w = MAX(0, A - 0.002)
_door_h = MAX(0, ZZYZX - 0.002)

! 厨房吊柜 3D Script
! 原点位于柜体左前下角，单位为米

PEN 1
TOLER 0.001

MATERIAL mat_body

! 左侧板
BLOCK panel_thk, B, ZZYZX

! 右侧板
ADDX A - panel_thk
BLOCK panel_thk, B, ZZYZX
DEL 1

! 底板
ADDZ 0
BLOCK _inner_w, B, panel_thk
DEL 1

! 顶板
ADD panel_thk, 0, ZZYZX - panel_thk
BLOCK _inner_w, B, panel_thk
DEL 1

! 背板
ADD panel_thk, B - back_thk, panel_thk
BLOCK _inner_w, back_thk, ZZYZX - 2 * panel_thk
DEL 1

! 层板阵列
FOR i = 1 TO n_shelves
    ADD panel_thk, 0, panel_thk + i * _shelf_spacing - panel_thk / 2
    BLOCK _inner_w, _shelf_depth, panel_thk
    DEL 1
NEXT i

IF has_door = 1 THEN
    MATERIAL mat_door
    ADD 0.001, -door_thk - 0.002, 0.001
    BLOCK _door_w, door_thk, _door_h
    DEL 1

    MATERIAL mat_hardware

    ! 两个简化铰链
    FOR i = 1 TO 2
        ADD _hinge_x - 0.006, -door_thk - 0.006, i * _door_h / 3
        BLOCK 0.012, 0.006, 0.030
        DEL 1
    NEXT i

    ! 简化把手
    ADD _handle_x - 0.006, -door_thk - 0.010, _door_h / 2
    BLOCK 0.012, 0.010, 0.080
    DEL 1
ENDIF

END

    _resol = 12

IF detail_level = 2 THEN
    _tol = 0.005
    _resol = 24
ENDIF
IF detail_level = 3 THEN
    _tol = 0.002
    _resol = 36
ENDIF

TOLER _tol
RESOL _resol

_base_r = base_d / 2
_top_r = top_d / 2

PUT 0, 0, 0
PUT _base_r, 0, 0

FOR i = 1 TO seg_count
    _t0 = (i - 1) / seg_count
    _t1 = (i - 0.82) / seg_count
    _t2 = (i - 0.50) / seg_count
    _t3 = (i - 0.18) / seg_count

    _r2 = _base_r + (_top_r - _base_r) * _t2

    PUT _r2 * _bulge, _t2 * ZZYZX, 0
    PUT _r3 * 0.72, _t3 * ZZYZX, 0
NEXT i

PUT 0, ZZYZX, 0

    _z_hot = i * ZZYZX / seg_count

NEXT i

END

BLOCK A, _plate_depth, B

ADD A / 2 - bracket_thk / 2, 0, _rail_center_z - bracket_thk / 2
BLOCK bracket_thk, _arm_center_y, bracket_thk
DEL 1

ADD A / 2 - _saddle_w / 2, _arm_center_y - bracket_thk, _rail_center_z - bracket_thk
BLOCK _saddle_w, bracket_thk * 2, bracket_thk
DEL 1

ADD 0, _arm_center_y, _rail_center_z
ROTY 90
CYLIND A, rail_d / 2
DEL 2

MATERIAL mat_fastener
FOR i = 1 TO bolt_count
    _bolt_z = bracket_thk + (i - 1) * _bolt_spacing
    IF bolt_count = 1 THEN _bolt_z = B / 2
    ADD A / 2, _plate_depth, _bolt_z
    ROTX 90
    CYLIND _plate_depth * 1.5, _bolt_d / 2
    DEL 2
NEXT i

END

IF hole_count < 1 THEN hole_count = 1
IF hole_count > 100 THEN hole_count = 100
hole_count = INT(hole_count)

IF hole_spacing <= 0 THEN hole_spacing = 0.10
IF hole_d <= 0 THEN hole_d = 0.024

_t_flange = MAX(0.012, MIN(0.03, ZZYZX * 0.08))
_t_web = MAX(0.008, MIN(B * 0.35, ZZYZX * 0.025))

_clear_height = MAX(0.004, ZZYZX - 2 * _t_flange - 0.004)
hole_d = MIN(hole_d, _clear_height)
hole_d = MIN(hole_d, MAX(0.004, A))

usable_length = MAX(0, A - hole_d)
array_length = MAX(0, (hole_count - 1) * hole_spacing)
effective_spacing = MIN(hole_spacing, usable_length / MAX(1, hole_count - 1))
array_span = (hole_count - 1) * effective_spacing
array_start = hole_d / 2 + MAX(0, (usable_length - array_span) / 2)
hole_y = 0

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
HOTSPOT2 0, -B / 2
HOTSPOT2 A, -B / 2
HOTSPOT2 0, B / 2
HOTSPOT2 A, B / 2
HOTSPOT2 array_start, hole_y
HOTSPOT2 array_start + array_span, hole_y

RECT2 0, -B / 2, A, B

FOR i = 1 TO hole_count
    _hole_x = array_start + (i - 1) * effective_spacing
    CIRCLE2 _hole_x, hole_y, hole_d / 2
NEXT i

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
MATERIAL mat_steel
TOLER 0.001

GROUP "beam_body"
    ADD 0, -B / 2, 0
        BLOCK A, B, _t_flange
    DEL 1

    ADD 0, -B / 2, ZZYZX - _t_flange
        BLOCK A, B, _t_flange
    DEL 1

    ADD 0, -_t_web / 2, _t_flange
        BLOCK A, _t_web, ZZYZX - 2 * _t_flange
    DEL 1
ENDGROUP

GROUP "bolt_holes"
    FOR i = 1 TO hole_count
        _hole_x = array_start + (i - 1) * effective_spacing

        ADD _hole_x, -_t_web / 2 - 0.01, ZZYZX / 2
            ROTX -90
                CYLIND _t_web + 0.02, hole_d / 2
            DEL 1
        DEL 1
    NEXT i
ENDGROUP

SUBGROUP "beam_body", "bolt_holes"
PLACEGROUP "beam_body"

END

NEXT iPanel

    FOR iFrame = 1 TO 4
        GOSUB "DrawBottomFrame"
    NEXT iFrame

    FOR iEdge = 1 TO 4
        GOSUB "DrawSlopeFrame"
    NEXT iEdge

    BLOCK frame_w * 2, frame_w * 2, frame_d
    DEL 1

"DrawGlassPanel":
    panel_ntr = NTR()

    IF iPanel = 1 THEN
        ADD 0, -_halfB, 0
        ROTX _slopeA
        PRISM_ 3, glass_thk, 0, 0, 0, A, 0, 0, A / 2, _slopeLenA, 0
    ENDIF

    IF iPanel = 2 THEN
        ADD 0, _halfB, 0
        ROTX -_slopeA
        PRISM_ 3, glass_thk, 0, 0, 0, A, 0, 0, A / 2, _slopeLenA, 0
    ENDIF

    IF iPanel = 3 THEN
        ADD _halfA, 0, 0
        ROTZ 90
        ROTX _slopeB
        PRISM_ 3, glass_thk, 0, 0, 0, B, 0, 0, B / 2, _slopeLenB, 0
    ENDIF

    IF iPanel = 4 THEN
        ADD -_halfA, 0, 0
        ROTZ -90
        ROTX -_slopeB
        PRISM_ 3, glass_thk, 0, 0, 0, B, 0, 0, B / 2, _slopeLenB, 0
    ENDIF

    DEL NTR() - panel_ntr
RETURN

"DrawBottomFrame":
    frame_ntr = NTR()

    IF iFrame = 1 THEN
        ADD 0, -_halfB - frame_w / 2, 0
        BLOCK A + frame_w, frame_w, frame_d
    ENDIF

    IF iFrame = 2 THEN
        ADD 0, _halfB - frame_w / 2, 0
        BLOCK A + frame_w, frame_w, frame_d
    ENDIF

    IF iFrame = 3 THEN
        ADD _halfA - frame_w / 2, 0, 0
        BLOCK frame_w, B + frame_w, frame_d
    ENDIF

    IF iFrame = 4 THEN
        ADD -_halfA - frame_w / 2, 0, 0
        BLOCK frame_w, B + frame_w, frame_d
    ENDIF

    DEL NTR() - frame_ntr
RETURN

"DrawSlopeFrame":
    edge_ntr = NTR()

    IF iEdge = 1 THEN
        ADD -_halfA, -_halfB, 0
        ROTZ _edgeAngle1
        ROTY -_beamAng
        BLOCK _beamLen, frame_w, frame_d
    ENDIF

    IF iEdge = 2 THEN
        ADD _halfA, -_halfB, 0
        ROTZ _edgeAngle2
        ROTY -_beamAng
        BLOCK _beamLen, frame_w, frame_d
    ENDIF

    IF iEdge = 3 THEN
        ADD _halfA, _halfB, 0
        ROTZ _edgeAngle3
        ROTY -_beamAng
        BLOCK _beamLen, frame_w, frame_d
    ENDIF

    IF iEdge = 4 THEN
        ADD -_halfA, _halfB, 0
        ROTZ _edgeAngle4
        ROTY -_beamAng
        BLOCK _beamLen, frame_w, frame_d
    ENDIF

    DEL NTR() - edge_ntr
RETURN

! H型钢柱梁节点 Master Script

IF A < 0.10 THEN A = 0.10
IF B < 0.10 THEN B = 0.10
IF ZZYZX < 0.30 THEN ZZYZX = 0.30

IF col_hw <= 2 * col_tf THEN col_hw = 2 * col_tf + 0.010
IF col_bf <= 0.02 THEN col_bf = 0.02
IF col_tf <= 0.001 THEN col_tf = 0.001
IF col_tw <= 0.001 THEN col_tw = 0.001

IF beam_bf <= 0.02 THEN beam_bf = 0.02
IF beam_tf <= 0.001 THEN beam_tf = 0.001
IF beam_tw <= 0.001 THEN beam_tw = 0.001
IF beam_len <= 0.10 THEN beam_len = 0.10

IF bolt_rows < 1 THEN bolt_rows = 1
IF bolt_cols < 1 THEN bolt_cols = 1
IF bolt_d <= 0.002 THEN bolt_d = 0.002
IF bolt_spacing_row <= bolt_d THEN bolt_spacing_row = bolt_d * 2
IF bolt_spacing_col <= bolt_d THEN bolt_spacing_col = bolt_d * 2

node_z = ZZYZX / 2

required_plate_w = bolt_edge_y * 2 + (bolt_cols - 1) * bolt_spacing_col

! H型钢柱梁节点 3D Script
! 柱竖直沿Z，梁沿X向外伸出，连接板位于柱翼缘外侧

TOLER 0.001

! 柱腹板
MATERIAL mat_column
ADD -col_tw / 2, col_tf, 0
BLOCK col_tw, col_clear_h, ZZYZX
DEL 1

! 柱下翼缘
ADD -col_bf / 2, 0, 0
BLOCK col_bf, col_tf, ZZYZX
DEL 1

! 柱上翼缘
ADD -col_bf / 2, col_hw - col_tf, 0
BLOCK col_bf, col_tf, ZZYZX
DEL 1

! 单侧连接板
MATERIAL mat_plate
ADD col_bf / 2, -plate_w / 2, node_z - plate_h / 2
BLOCK plate_t, plate_w, plate_h
DEL 1

! 梁腹板
MATERIAL mat_beam
ADD col_bf / 2 + plate_t, -beam_tw / 2, node_z - beam_hw / 2 + beam_tf
BLOCK beam_len, beam_tw, beam_hw - 2 * beam_tf
DEL 1

! 梁下翼缘
ADD col_bf / 2 + plate_t, -beam_bf / 2, node_z - beam_hw / 2
BLOCK beam_len, beam_bf, beam_tf
DEL 1

! 梁上翼缘
ADD col_bf / 2 + plate_t, -beam_bf / 2, node_z + beam_hw / 2 - beam_tf
BLOCK beam_len, beam_bf, beam_tf
DEL 1

! 螺栓组：行向沿Z，列向沿Y
MATERIAL mat_bolt
FOR i = 1 TO bolt_rows
    FOR j = 1 TO bolt_cols
        ADD col_bf / 2 - 0.020, bolt_y0 + (j - 1) * bolt_spacing_col, bolt_z0 + (i - 1) * bolt_spacing_row
        ROTY 90
        CYLIND plate_t + 0.040, bolt_d / 2
        DEL 2

        ADD col_bf / 2 + plate_t + 0.020, bolt_y0 + (j - 1) * bolt_spacing_col, bolt_z0 + (i - 1) * bolt_spacing_row
        ROTY 90
        CYLIND 0.020, bolt_d * 0.85
        DEL 2
    NEXT j
NEXT i

! 可选加劲肋：上下翼缘与连接板之间的矩形简化肋板
IF has_stiff = 1 THEN
    MATERIAL mat_stiff

    ADD col_bf / 2, -stiff_w / 2, node_z - beam_hw / 2 + beam_tf
    BLOCK stiff_len, stiff_w, stiff_h
    DEL 1

    ADD col_bf / 2, -stiff_w / 2, node_z - beam_tf
    BLOCK stiff_len, stiff_w, stiff_h
    DEL 1
ENDIF

END
